speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing fatigue and severe itching, and your liver tests are abnormal. Can you tell me more about your symptoms, such as when they started and if you have noticed any changes in your urine or stool color?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any dark urine or pale stools, and have you noticed any jaundice or right upper quadrant abdominal pain? Given your history of ulcerative colitis, this could suggest primary sclerosing cholangitis, but I need to rule out viral hepatitis.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Pneumonia and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: I must clarify that your symptoms of jaundice and pruritus with abnormal liver tests are not typical for pneumonia, which primarily affects the lungs. Given your history of ulcerative colitis, I am highly suspicious of Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis, but I need to rule out other causes. REQUEST TEST: MRCP

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal MRCP rules out Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis, so I need to investigate other causes like viral hepatitis given your sexual history. REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis_A, B, and C panel

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hepatitis A: Negative (Anti-HAV IgM negative), Hepatitis B: Negative (HBsAg negative, Anti-HBs negative, Anti-HBc negative), Hepatitis C: Negative (Anti-HCV negative)

speaker: Doctor
text: Since viral hepatitis and PSC are ruled out, I need to assess for autoimmune causes given your history of inflammatory bowel disease. Do you have a personal or family history of autoimmune conditions like thyroid disease or type 1 diabetes? REQUEST TEST: Autoimmune_hepatitis_panel

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Anti-Nuclear Antibody: Negative, Antimitochondrial Antibodies: Negative

speaker: Doctor
text: With autoimmune hepatitis and PSC ruled out, I need to investigate other causes of cholestasis. REQUEST TEST: Liver_Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Liver biopsy shows chronic nonsuppurative destructive cholangitis with concentric periductal fibrosis ("onion-skinning") and bile duct loss, consistent with Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis.

speaker: Doctor
text: The liver biopsy confirms Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis, despite the earlier normal MRCP which can sometimes miss small duct disease. DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis
